overall_note: The recorded attempt PASSED all nine of its items; those results are unchanged below. The unit conclusion is BLOCKED because G2a has a second half - verifying that the Go supervisor carries the fixed native transport (plan section 13.1: 'first deliver the Go supervisor's direct argv check path, then verify that it carries the fixed native transport'; section 13.1 prose: 'G2a first verifies command supervision, then verifies that it carries the native transport'). That half was authorized on 2026-09-17, executed, and stopped at a host permission request. Plan section 13.1 keeps a unit unaccepted when a necessary native verification is blocked by permission, service or fee authorization, and section 14.3 forbids relabelling a blocked verification as NOT_APPLICABLE or treating a missing result as PASS.

native_verification.authorized: 2026-09-17, explicit fee authorization from the user
native_verification.blocker: NATIVE_BLOCKED: RuntimeBlocked: DSH_INTERACTION_REQUIRED: native permission needs a user decision; none was sent
native_verification.blocker_cause: The product-review role asked for an out-of-sandbox escalation: its bash tool call carried sandbox_permissions='danger-full-access'. DSH turned that into session/request_permission and the turn ended aborted/user. This version has no native-answer path (the permission bridge is recorded as not implemented), so no answer could be delivered.
native_verification.blocker_is_not_a_regression: Same host and version, and a byte-identical harness tool policy apart from the job-directory path, as the earlier run live-20260915-2050 which reached HARNESS_COMPLETE with 7 roles. That run made 32 bash calls - 16 of them operating inside the run's workspaces/ directories and 13 running the same class of check command - with 0 escalation fields and 0 permission requests in any of its seven jobs. So the trigger is the model's own escalation request, not the path scope, the configuration or the Go supervisor.

supervisor_half_proven.process_group: supervisor pid == pgid (30044); the native child (30048) is its child in its group
supervisor_half_proven.note: The supervisor executed the native argv as an ordinary child, owned it, wrote a six-field receipt and relayed the child's streams verbatim. The pre-migration supervisor can no longer run at all (the module is gone), so the receipt can only have come from the Go binary.

native_verification.missing_for_acceptance: a native completion correlation: no role reached a completed turn, so the minimum evidence of plan section 13.1 ('real host/config, native request and completion correlation, actual file or server-side evidence') is not satisfied

budget.note: The regression is judged by result and progress, not by wall-clock speed.
